[center][color=#00ff00][size=6][font=Georgia][b][i][u]Sounds Of The Valley Framework[/u][/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]


[font=Georgia][b][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]There's nothing quite like adding ultra-realistic sounds to a 2D pixel art game, right? Now you can do it![/size][/color][/i][/b][/font]


[font=Georgia][size=4][b]This framework allows you to edit the game's sounds and replace them with whatever sounds you want, regardless of their source or nature; it's up to you to decide whether or not they fit what you're looking for.[/b][/size][/font]


[font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=5][b][u]This mod offers:[/u][/b][/size][/color][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia]Compatibility with the Android/mobile version.[/font][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia]Support for .ogg and .wav audio formats.[/font][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia]In-game sound editing, including volume, pitch, delay, and playback timing.[/font][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia]The ability to set conditions so that sounds play only when those conditions are met.[/font][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia]Multiple audio samples for a single sound to add variation and randomness.[/font][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia]Allows you to isolate a sound that is reused multiple times, enabling you to modify a specific instance (such as the Furnace sound, which is shared with the Pepper Rex’s Breath).[/font][/size][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Georgia][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]In the downloads, you'll find a template showing how to create a Content Patcher to modify sounds, along with a final example and useful information about what each variant does.[/b][/size][/color][/font]

[size=4][font=Georgia][b]As a general rule, .ogg files are used for long-duration files because they take up the least amount of space (with minimal loss of quality), while .wav files are used for sound effects that last only a few seconds (which can retain their full quality).[/b][/font][/size]

[font=Georgia][size=4]Please note that the mod is designed for the PC version; while the mobile version is functional, some features are limited due to the way that version of the game is built. However, most of the mod is—and should be—functional. [/size][/font]


[font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]So that's it. You can always ask for help if you create a mod and it's not working properly. There might be bugs, so please report them if you feel something isn't right, if the game crashes, etc, these things can always happen.[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
